text:
harper: Wow, surprise downpour on the way to the office. Pigeon tried to hitch a ride on my hood. Is this peak season for soggy pigeons? :umbrella: :dove:

jules: I saw that same pigeon earlier. It judged my life choices and then stole a pretzel. Weather mood: chaotic pastry theft.

kai: Bus 22 just pulled up soaked and the driver announced: "We are accepting soggy commuters and small life regrets." I love a driver with branding.

marco: Quick poll: who needs a dry spot in a carpool? React with :one: if yes, :two: if no, :three: if you can offer a ride.

jules: :one: my shoes are making soup noises.

harper: :three: I can take one person from Dogpatch to Soma in 20 min. Will have towels and a very sad playlist.

kai: :two: I am marching on with heroic sogginess. Also PSA: check your bike brakes, they are slippery today.

transit-bot: Muni alert: "Service delays on 22 and 10 due to heavy rain and street water. Consider alternate routes." https://status.sfmta.example/alerts

marco: Also random office logistics: if you bring a wet umbrella inside please leave it in the foyer umbrella rack (label it with name or shame it publicly). We have a spare hair dryer in pantry closet 2 for emergencies.

jules: @marco labeling tip: write your initials on a Post-it and duct-tape to the handle. Works every time.

harper: Heading to the foyer now to rescue soggy pigeon survivors. If you need a ride DM me. Also will be at the 9:30 stand if not abducted by pastries.

weather-bot: Weather update: "Short heavy showers expected for next 45 minutes, light winds. Urban pooling likely. Temperatures 52F."

kai: If anyone loses a pretzel, I will form a search party. Also offering sympathetic ear for soggy shoes.

marco: Meeting note: if rain persists, we'll move the 10am sync to huddle room B (it's dryer). Will post update in 10. Stay warm y'all. :wave:
